briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push frontier as safety gaps widen globally

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race accelerates with multiple frontier releases this month amid escalating geopolitical tensions. Compute scaling continues aggressively while regulatory frameworks lag. Prompt injection vulnerabilities persist across deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning; xAI launched Grok-4; DeepSeek-V3.5 and Meta Llama-4 variants dropped in rapid succession. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus leads on safety benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft announced $40B hyperscale buildout in Texas; TSMC ramps 2nm AI chip production; Google TPU v6 clusters now online in three new regions.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first company to achieve 10x human-level agent performance trigger an immediate global compute arms race?
